title: Quietly Quenched Venezuelan Tofu Salad
description: A winey, light, festive Venezuelan dish featuring silken tofu, infused oil, and ovo-vegetarian friendly ingredients, served in a mason jar.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together infused oil, white wine vinegar, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cubed silken tofu to the bowl and toss gently to combine.
In a separate bowl, combine the sliced red onion, diced red bell pepper, halved cherry tomatoes, and sliced cucumber.
Add the diced hard boiled egg to the bowl with the vegetables and toss gently to combine.
Add the vegetable and egg mixture to the bowl with the tofu and toss gently to combine.
Spoon the salad into a mason jar and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the salad chilled, garnished with additional chopped herbs if desired.
Store any leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
